Clancy mistrial fallout turns on holdout juror's background

tags: legal, courts
sources: @aaronparnas

An NBC Boston investigation reported that the lone holdout juror in the Lindsey Clancy trial, a 30-year-old man, had prior domestic violence allegations and faced evictions. Under Massachusetts law a person may serve on a jury unless they have a felony conviction less than seven years old or a pending felony indictment, neither of which applied to him; both prosecutors and defense receive juror names and can question them under oath during voir dire. Because the trial ended in a mistrial rather than a final judgment, there is no verdict to appeal on that ground. The defense has filed a motion arguing double jeopardy bars a retrial, and a hearing on whether jeopardy attached is set for September 29.

Kimmel interview outdraws Trump convention speech after attempt to keep it off air

tags: media, politics
sources: @aaronparnas

Jimmy Kimmel's interview with James Talarico, which President Trump sought to keep off the air, has passed 5.8 million views on YouTube and continues to climb. Trump's convention speech drew about 2.5 million viewers on Fox, below the network's typical audience in the 9-to-10 p.m. hour. Kimmel's subscriber count has also risen since the episode aired.

Thousands protest Trump's visit across Ireland

tags: politics, protest
sources: @aaronparnas

Protests against President Trump have broken out across Ireland during his visit to the country, drawing thousands of demonstrators. European media coverage showed crowds carrying messages telling Trump he is not welcome. Trump has said he does not see the protests.

Indonesian wildfires drive record emissions and displace wildlife

tags: climate, environment
sources: @aaronparnas

Wildfires in Indonesia's Kalimantan region have forced animals out of their habitats, with footage first posted by Popbase Indonesia showing a slow loris taking refuge on power lines in a residential area. Emissions from the fires have surged to the highest level of any wildfires worldwide.
